source_name: Lugera Slovakia – blog and 30-year market commentary
why_relevant: Long-established SK recruitment firm (founded Trenčín 1996, permanent placement + executive search); blog carries market/recruitment-trend commentary and its Slovak Spectator profile gives corporate background.
IT/RPO recruiter with Slovak roots; blog covers IT talent supply (SAP, MS Dynamics) relevant to bank/payments technology hiring, though not banking-specific.

Largest SK career fair (Bratislava 22–23 Apr 2026, Stará tržnica; also Košice). The exhibitor roster and programme reveal which banks/fintechs are in active mass-hiring mode and which functions they showcase (trainee, IT, shared services).

Profesia's B2B channel publishes labour-market statistics derived from the dominant SK job portal (offer volumes, response rates, scarce roles) — the closest thing to an index of SK hiring demand, segmentable by sector.

source_name: HRhub.sk – Slovak HR knowledge hub and events
why_relevant: HR-industry media/community: speaker line-ups and case studies name HR directors and transformation projects at Slovak banks, pointing to reorganisations before they are announced publicly.

source_name: TREND konferencie – HR manažment conference series
why_relevant: Business-media conference organiser; the HR manažment editions list speakers by name and employer, a reliable way to track who currently runs HR at Slovak banks and insurers and what change programmes they present.

source_name: Index SME – rebríčky executive search firiem
why_relevant: Business magazine Index (SME) ranks Slovak executive search firms by revenue, partners and filled senior positions — the authoritative actor map for this cell and a source of aggregate placement volumes.

source_name: GreenPages.sk – executive search / personálne agentúry directory (Kariéra Guide)
why_relevant: Directory tied to the Kariéra Guide publication; enumerates SK executive search and staffing firms (incl. smaller local players such as TARGET Executive Search, Personality Group, Perfect Personal) that generic searches miss.
International staffing firm with a Slovak entity doing recruitment and headhunting for shared-services and finance functions; job feed and insights show which SK finance/BPO functions are scaling.
Operator of the national wage-survey infrastructure (ISCP) and labour-market forecasts; the reference dataset against which recruiter salary claims for banking roles can be validated.

source_name: Našeplaty.sk / WageIndicator SK – banking & finance salary overview
why_relevant: Crowdsourced SK salary database with a dedicated banking & finance section; free cross-check on recruiter-published pay benchmarks for teller, back-office and specialist roles.

source_name: FinReport.sk – agency news on financial-sector employers
why_relevant: Slovak financial-sector trade outlet that reprints agency wires on employer awards, HR appointments and sector personnel news — a convenient aggregator for A5 signals in the finance vertical.
Aggregator/lead portal listing Slovak staffing agencies by specialisation; useful for completing the actor map beyond the international brands.

Slovakia's main business daily online. Covers bank layoffs, branch closures, cost programmes and executive appointments; its finance/companies desk is one of the few that chases numbers banks do not announce.

source_name: SITA Financie / vofinanciach (SITA news agency financial desk)
why_relevant: Wire service producing dated, quotable primary text on bank CEO changes and union disputes. Observed items: 'Slovenska sporitelna ma novu generalnu riaditelku, stala sa nou Michaela Bauer' and 'UniCredit Bank meni vedenie. Marco Iannaccone nahradi generalneho riaditela Jakuba Dusilka' and 'Banky na Slovensku odmietaju rokovat o mzdach napriek ziskom, OZBP ziada zasah ministerstva'.
Dedicated wire tag archive aggregating appointment/dismissal items across sectors including banks — an ideal seed list for building an actor map of Slovak financial executives.

State news agency TASR's free-to-read portal; the canonical dated primary text for official appointments, ministry/NBS-related nominations and company announcements. TASR items are widely republished, so it anchors first-publication timestamps.

A dedicated standing personnel/people column inside a national daily's economy desk — exactly the 'ludia a kariery / personalie' channel this cell targets. Pravda's economy desk also tracks mass-layoff notifications filed with labour offices.

source_name: Index SME — economic desk of Denník SME
why_relevant: Economic web + monthly magazine with manager interviews and company profiles; runs per-company tag pages (e.g. Postova banka) that aggregate all coverage of a given bank, useful for tracking executive churn and restructuring over time.

source_name: Denník E — economic desk of Denník N (incl. Ekonomicky newsfilter)
why_relevant: Investigative-leaning economic desk; its daily 'Ekonomicky newsfilter' regularly flags layoffs and management exits, and it runs long interviews with bank CEOs. Strong on exits under pressure and disputes that companies do not announce.

Public-service broadcaster carrying sector labour stories such as bank employees' pay demands and the SBA's refusal to bargain — useful corroboration and often includes on-record interviews with union and association representatives.

High-traffic consumer finance portal that republishes and reports sector labour and management news (e.g. unions criticising banks over refusal to bargain despite record profits) and maintains a directory of banks operating in Slovakia.

Fast, high-reach popular business site that repackages bank leadership changes ('Banky menia vedenie: UniCredit dostane noveho generalneho riaditela, Privatbanka posilnuje predstavenstvo') and pay/profit disputes. Useful as an early low-latency alerting layer, not as an authority.

source_name: Slovak aggregator/rewrite tier (24hod.sk, Topky.sk, Androidportal.sk, Kryptomagazin.sk, Emefka.sk, Regiony/bratislava.zoznam.sk)
why_relevant: A broad rewrite layer that surfaces bank layoff and branch-closure narratives with aggressive headlines ('Banky na Slovensku v KRIZE: MASIVNE zatvaranie pobociek a prepustanie'). Low authority, but excellent for cheap recall: they mirror wire items that sit behind paywalls elsewhere, and their pickup volume is itself a signal of how salient a restructuring story is.
Commercial-TV economy desk covering labour-market and unemployment outlooks that frame bank restructuring decisions; broad reach means it often carries executive-change soundbites.

source_name: TREND TOP awards / TREND konferencie (etrend events franchise)
why_relevant: TREND's annual awards ('manazer roka', 'banka roka', 'investor', 'exporter') and its conference programmes name the executives the sector currently treats as principals — a reliable, dated way to enumerate active bank leadership and spot who is being positioned or has just moved.

source_name: Parlamentne listy SK — labour/union arena coverage
why_relevant: Carries union-side and politically framed accounts of bank employment conditions and strike threats that mainstream outlets under-report; useful for early detection of labour conflict, but strongly opinionated and needs corroboration.
